newsitem.title: UK: Oct N.Sea Flotta crude programme 7.25 mln barrels.
newsitem.headline: Oct N.Sea Flotta crude programme 7.25 mln barrels.

text.p: Britain's North Sea Flotta crude system will load a total of 7.25 million barrels in October, slightly above September's scheduled 6.7 million barrels, traders said.
The October programme includes one cargo of 650,000 barrels, nine of 600,000 barrels each, two of 500,000 barrels each and two top up cargoes of 100,000 barrels each, traders said.
The September programme scheduled seven cargoes of 600,000 barrels and five of 500,000 barrels each.
Traders said the higher October programme mainly reflected the fact that there was one more day of production in the month.
